name: Product of hyperplane, cubic cone in separate variables

intrinsic.summary: 3 blowups with smooth centres (1 at points, 1 along curves, 1 along larger centres); 19 final charts.

dual_complex.convention: Exceptional divisor on the smooth strict transform in the germ over the origin over Qbar.

certificate.method: Blowups with smooth centres; certified by ideal calculations. Centre rule: maximal order
certificate.description: Every centre is smooth. In every final chart the strict transform is smooth on its part of the origin fibre by the Jacobian criterion. Properness gives the same conclusion over a neighbourhood of the origin.
certificate.atlas_verification: Strict transform on the owned origin fibre

embedded.summary: Regular Newton resolution with 5 charts and 1 geometric exceptional components.
